name: 64735 · Clinton, MO
findings: ZIP 64735 (Clinton) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64735 (Clinton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
62% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 64735 (Clinton) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).
